sentences.text:
12.03.2025 Mr. Gupta, learned AAG appearing for the Respondent No. 2 submits that pursuant to the issuance of indent by the Chief Engineer, Public Works Department (R&B) and making all the requisite funds available with the Collector, a formal Notification under Section 11 (1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013 has been issued.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He further submits that the acquisition proceedings are now to be taken by the Collector, strictly as per the provisions of the Act of 2013.

In view of the aforesaid, this contempt petition is disposed of by directing that the Collector Land Acquisition concerned shall complete the acquisition proceedings, strictly within the time frame,
laid down in the Act of 2013.
 (Moksha Khajuria Kazmi) (Sanjeev Rajesh Kumar & Anr vs Sunil Kumar Bhutyal & Anr on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164643501/
